summary: Verified Navbar submenu (dropdown) readability fix. In default LIGHT mode over the dark hero on /, hovering nav-products and nav-company opens SOLID opaque panels (bg = rgb(255,255,255), opacity 1) with dark readable text (rgb(11,18,32)). In DARK mode the panel is a solid dark surface (bg = rgb(5,7,13)) with white text. Navigation from submenu items works (verified nav-child-xoexam -> /xoexam-eye-exam). Scroll glass state swaps logo to dark and applies 'glass py-3'. localStorage 'xo-theme' persists as 'dark' after toggle. All tested routes render without runtime/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx uses 'bg-bg' which resolves to fully-opaque rgb(var(--bg)/1) — correct. Consider using bg-bg/95 with backdrop-blur for a subtle floating glass effect if desired, but current solid panel is fine and matches the bug-fix intent.
Minor: lenis warning 'container needs non-static position' logs on every navigation — cosmetic, but worth addressing by adding position:relative to the scroll container.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dropdown/submenu opacity + readability fix verified via computed styles (backgroundColor + text color) in both light and dark themes over the dark hero at scrollY=0. Route smoke tests passed for /, /xoexam-eye-exam, /xoiris-scheduling, /xofit-frame-fitting, /xolab-eyewear-finishing, /about, /team, /news, /request-a-demo (0 page errors).
rca of the issue: Previous bug: dropdown panel used 'bg-bg/98' which is not a valid Tailwind opacity step (Tailwind only supports up to /95 in default scale). Invalid class was dropped by Tailwind → panel had no background → transparent over dark hero with dark text = invisible in light mode. Fix: replaced with 'bg-bg' (solid) which uses rgb(var(--bg)) semantic token that flips between light/dark themes.
